title: orders.estimate-issued.v1
description: A priced estimate was issued against an open draft. An estimate is a quote and not a stage of the order: it is never posted and never consumes an invoice number (INV-ORD-04), so a consumer that treated this as a receivable would be treating a quotation as a debt. The payload carries no money at all — a price snapshot is Confidential under docs/nfr/data-classification.md section 2.1 and section 3 admits Confidential data to an integration event only for an approved subscriber, of which there is none; #42 reads the priced result through IOrderSnapshotQuery and recalculates. There is no estimate-superseded and no estimate-converted event: a reissue is already announced by orders.order-revised.v1's supersededEstimateId and a conversion by orders.order-confirmed.v1's estimateId.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the estimate was issued, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The estimate this event announces. It is the thing the event is about, so it is the thing per-aggregate ordering is preserved against — the same choice customers.measurement-version-confirmed.v1 makes with the version it confirms.

organisationId.description: The organisation the estimate belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch that issued it, and whose sequence the number came from. Never null: branch scope is evaluated and never inferred, so an estimate with no branch could not have been numbered honestly.

customerId.description: The customer it was quoted to. An identifier and nothing more — no name, no telephone number, no address (docs/nfr/data-classification.md section 5.2). A consumer that must name the person asks ICustomerSnapshotQuery, which re-authorises the read and masks what the caller may not see.

orderDraftId.description: The draft that was priced. An estimate is a snapshot of a draft and not of an order, because there is no order yet; the draft is what a confirmation that follows is keyed on.

estimateNumber.description: The human reference, E-<branch>-<FY>-000001 (docs/architecture/conventions.md section 3.2). A display number a person quotes over the counter, and never a lookup key — every reference is by aggregateId.

issuedOn.description: The branch-local date it was issued on, already evaluated in the branch timezone (docs/architecture/conventions.md section 2.2).

validUntil.description: The branch-local date it stops being honourable. The one fact on an estimate that decays, and never earlier than issuedOn.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
